content.json:
# Verified SaaS Usage – Identity Journey

One row per **SaaS App × User**, showing the full verification journey: **Sign-in → MFA → MFA Method → Conditional Access → Recency**. Use the filters below.

> **Column meaning:** In **Approaches A/B** the recency column is `SignInRecency` = whether the user's last **sign-in** to the app falls inside the selected **Time Range**. In **Approaches C/D** it is `MDCAActivity` = whether the user performed an **in-app action captured by MDCA** (`CloudAppEvents`) inside the selected **Time Range**.

> **Blank / GUID app names:** Non-interactive sign-ins often do not populate `AppDisplayName`; the app is only identified by an `AppId` GUID. These queries fall back to `ResourceDisplayName` then `AppId`, so you get a value instead of a blank.

> **Filtering to specific apps:** The **Application** filter is **multi-select** — tick the 5–10 apps the customer cares about (or leave **All**). Every table below filters to your selection.

> **Prerequisite:** Microsoft Entra ID **P1/P2** with the **Entra ID** data connector enabled (`SigninLogs` and/or `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`). If the table shows *no data* and the **Application** filter is empty, the selected **Workspace** is not ingesting sign-in logs — check the **Data availability** row below, widen the **Time Range**, or pick a different **Workspace**.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id, name
| order by name asc

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.label: Time Range
parameters.description: Select the time range for analysis

parameters.name: User
parameters.label: User (type UPN or name)
parameters.description: Type a full or partial UPN / name to filter — leave blank for all users

parameters.name: Application
parameters.label: Application
parameters.description: Filter by application — pick one or more (All = all apps). Populates after Workspace + Time Range are set.
parameters.query:
union isfuzzy=true (SigninLogs), (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs)
| where isnotempty(AppDisplayName)
| distinct AppDisplayName
| order by AppDisplayName asc
| take 1000

parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.label: Access Type (Approach D)
parameters.description: Filter Approach D by whether MDA activity was backed by a corporate sign-in

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(SigninLogs | summarize Rows = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), Apps = dcount(AppDisplayName) | extend Source = "SigninLogs (interactive)"),
(AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | summarize Rows = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), Apps = dcount(AppDisplayName) | extend Source = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs")
| project Source, Rows, Users, Apps
| order by Source asc
content.title: Data availability (selected time range)

content.query:
let Signin = union withsource=SourceTable isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs);
let Base = Signin
    | where '{User}' == '' or UserPrincipalName contains '{User}'
    | extend AppLabel = iff(isnotempty(AppDisplayName), AppDisplayName, coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ResourceDisplayName', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('AppId', ''))))
    | where 'value::all' in ({Application}) or '*' in ({Application}) or AppLabel in ({Application})
    | where '{AuthStatus}' == "All" or ('{AuthStatus}' == "Success" and ResultType == "0") or ('{AuthStatus}' == "Failure" and ResultType != "0")
    | extend Country = tostring(todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('LocationDetails', ''))).countryOrRegion);
let Methods = SigninLogs
    | where '{User}' == '' or UserPrincipalName contains '{User}'
    | extend AppLabel = iff(isnotempty(AppDisplayName), AppDisplayName, coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ResourceDisplayName', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('AppId', ''))))
    | where 'value::all' in ({Application}) or '*' in ({Application}) or AppLabel in ({Application})
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | extend AD = todynamic(tostring(column_ifexists('AuthenticationDetails', '[]')))
    | mv-expand ad = AD
    | extend Method = tostring(ad.authenticationMethod)
    | where isnotempty(Method) and Method != "Previously satisfied"
    | summarize MethodSet = make_set(Method, 10) by User = UserPrincipalName, Application = AppLabel;
Base
| summarize
    Name = take_any(UserDisplayName),
    Country = take_any(Country),
    Verified = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    Failed = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    Interactive = countif(SourceTable !has "NonInteractive"),
    MFACount = countif(AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication" and ResultType == "0"),
    CACount = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus == "success"),
    LastActive = max(TimeGenerated),
    TotalDaysUsed = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))
    by Application = AppLabel, User = UserPrincipalName
| join kind=leftouter Methods on User, Application
| extend
    Source = iff(Interactive > 0, "Interactive", "Non-interactive"),
    SignIn = iff(Verified > 0, "Verified", iff(Failed > 0, "Failed", "None")),
    MFA = iff(MFACount > 0, "Yes", "No"),
    MFAMethod = iff(isnotempty(MethodSet) and array_length(MethodSet) > 0, strcat_array(MethodSet, ", "), "-"),
    CAVerified = iff(CACount > 0, "Verified", "Not Applied"),
    SignInRecency = iff(LastActive > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s), "Active", "Inactive")
| project Application, User, Name, Country, Source, SignIn, MFA, MFAMethod, CAVerified, SignInRecency, TotalDaysUsed, LastActive
| order by Application asc, TotalDaysUsed desc
| take 1000
content.title: Approach A – Union (Interactive + Non-interactive) · App × User Journey

content.json:
---
### Approach B – Non-interactive sign-ins only (direct, no union)

Queries `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs` **directly** — no `union`, no `mv-expand`. This is the leanest path and should always return data when the table has rows. Compare it against **Approach A** above: if B shows rows and A is empty, the union/`mv-expand` was the blocker.

content.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where '{User}' == '' or UserPrincipalName contains '{User}'
| extend AppLabel = iff(isnotempty(AppDisplayName), AppDisplayName, coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ResourceDisplayName', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('AppId', ''))))
| where 'value::all' in ({Application}) or '*' in ({Application}) or AppLabel in ({Application})
| where '{AuthStatus}' == "All" or ('{AuthStatus}' == "Success" and ResultType == "0") or ('{AuthStatus}' == "Failure" and ResultType != "0")
| extend Country = tostring(todynamic(tostring(LocationDetails)).countryOrRegion)
| summarize
    Name = take_any(UserDisplayName),
    Country = take_any(Country),
    Verified = countif(ResultType == "0"),
    Failed = countif(ResultType != "0"),
    MFACount = countif(AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication" and ResultType == "0"),
    CACount = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus == "success"),
    LastActive = max(TimeGenerated),
    TotalDaysUsed = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))
    by Application = AppLabel, User = UserPrincipalName
| extend
    SignIn = iff(Verified > 0, "Verified", iff(Failed > 0, "Failed", "None")),
    MFA = iff(MFACount > 0, "Yes", "No"),
    CAVerified = iff(CACount > 0, "Verified", "Not Applied"),
    SignInRecency = iff(LastActive > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s), "Active", "Inactive")
| project Application, User, Name, Country, SignIn, MFA, CAVerified, SignInRecency, TotalDaysUsed, LastActive
| order by TotalDaysUsed desc
| take 1000
content.title: Approach B – Non-interactive sign-ins (direct) · App × User

content.json:
---
## Defender for Cloud Apps (MDA) comparison

Approaches **A/B** above use Entra sign-in logs (federated apps only). The two approaches below start from **MDA / Defender for Cloud Apps** discovery so you can answer the customer question: *for apps MDA reports, are users accessing them WITH corporate authentication or WITHOUT?*

- **Approach C** — MDA in-app **activity** directly (`CloudAppEvents`). `MDCAActivity` = user performed an in-app action captured by MDCA within the selected Time Range. Strongest "verified usage" signal; covers non-Entra apps.
- **Approach D** — MDA app × user **cross-referenced** with Entra sign-ins → `AccessType` = **Authenticated** (found in sign-in logs) vs **Unauthenticated** (MDA saw activity but no corporate sign-in).

> **Note:** The **Application** filter is populated from Entra sign-in logs, so its names (e.g. *Microsoft 365 Admin portal*) may not exactly match MDA app names (e.g. *Microsoft 365*). Approaches **C/D** therefore **fuzzy-match** your selection to MDA app names (case-insensitive substring, either direction) so a specific-app pick still scopes them. Over-broad names (e.g. *Office*) may pull in several MDA apps — leave **All** for the full MDA picture.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
(CloudAppEvents | summarize Rows = count(), Users = dcount(AccountObjectId), Apps = dcount(Application) | extend Source = "CloudAppEvents (MDA activity)"),
(McasShadowItReporting | summarize Rows = count(), Users = dcount(UserName), Apps = dcount(AppName) | extend Source = "McasShadowItReporting (Cloud Discovery)")
| project Source, Rows, Users, Apps
| order by Source asc
content.title: MDA data availability (selected time range)

content.query:
let SelApps = CloudAppEvents
| where isnotempty(Application)
| distinct Application
| extend _sel = dynamic([{Application}])
| mv-apply _s = _sel to typeof(string) on (
    summarize _hit = countif(_s == 'value::all' or _s == '*' or tolower(Application) == tolower(_s) or tolower(Application) contains tolower(_s) or tolower(_s) contains tolower(Application))
  )
| where _hit > 0
| distinct Application;
CloudAppEvents
| extend AccId = tostring(column_ifexists('AccountId', ''))
| extend AccName = tostring(column_ifexists('AccountDisplayName', ''))
| extend Ctry = tostring(column_ifexists('CountryCode', ''))
| extend UPN = iff(AccId has "@", tolower(AccId), "")
| extend UserId = iff(isnotempty(UPN), UPN, tolower(AccName))
| where 'value::all' in ({Application}) or '*' in ({Application}) or Application in (SelApps)
| where '{User}' == '' or UserId contains '{User}'
| summarize
    Name = take_any(AccName),
    Country = take_any(Ctry),
    Activities = count(),
    LastActive = max(TimeGenerated),
    TotalDaysUsed = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))
    by Application, User = UserId
| extend MDCAActivity = iff(LastActive > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s), "Active", "Inactive")
| project Application, User, Name, Country, Activities, TotalDaysUsed, LastActive, MDCAActivity
| order by Activities desc
| take 1000
content.title: Approach C – MDA activity (CloudAppEvents, direct) · App × User

content.query:
let SelApps = CloudAppEvents
| where isnotempty(Application)
| distinct Application
| extend _sel = dynamic([{Application}])
| mv-apply _s = _sel to typeof(string) on (
    summarize _hit = countif(_s == 'value::all' or _s == '*' or tolower(Application) == tolower(_s) or tolower(Application) contains tolower(_s) or tolower(_s) contains tolower(Application))
  )
| where _hit > 0
| distinct Application;
let MdaUsage = CloudAppEvents
    | extend AccId = tostring(column_ifexists('AccountId', ''))
    | extend AccName = tostring(column_ifexists('AccountDisplayName', ''))
    | extend UPN = iff(AccId has "@", tolower(AccId), tolower(AccName))
    | where 'value::all' in ({Application}) or '*' in ({Application}) or Application in (SelApps)
    | summarize MdaActivities = count(), LastActive = max(TimeGenerated), TotalDaysUsed = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d))
        by AppName = tolower(Application), UPN;
let Auth = union isfuzzy=true (SigninLogs), (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs)
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | summarize SignIns = count(),
        MFAHits = countif(AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"),
        CAHits = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus == "success")
        by AppName = tolower(AppDisplayName), UPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
MdaUsage
| join kind=leftouter Auth on AppName, UPN
| extend AccessType = iff(isnotempty(SignIns) and SignIns > 0, "Authenticated", "Unauthenticated")
| extend MFA = iff(MFAHits > 0, "Yes", "No"), CAVerified = iff(CAHits > 0, "Verified", "Not Applied"), MDCAActivity = iff(LastActive > ago({TimeRange:seconds}s), "Active", "Inactive")
| where '{User}' == '' or UPN contains '{User}'
| where '{AccessType}' == "All" or AccessType == '{AccessType}'
| project Application = AppName, User = UPN, AccessType, MFA, CAVerified, MdaActivities, TotalDaysUsed, LastActive, MDCAActivity
| order by AccessType asc, MdaActivities desc
| take 1000
content.title: Approach D – MDA × Entra cross-reference · Authenticated vs Unauthenticated

content.json:
---
## How the correlation works (and adding PingID / other IdPs)

**Join key used everywhere: `App × User`, lower-cased for case-insensitive matching.**

### Approach A — sign-in aggregate ⋈ MFA method
`join kind=leftouter Methods on User, Application` — correlates the per user/app sign-in summary with its set of MFA methods, matched on `UserPrincipalName` + `AppLabel`.

### Approach D — MDA activity ⋈ Entra authentication (the key one)
Two aggregates are built and left-joined:
- **MDA side** (`CloudAppEvents`): key = `tolower(Application)` + `UPN`, where `UPN = AccountId` when it looks like an email, else `AccountDisplayName`.
- **Entra side** (`SigninLogs` ∪ `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`, success only): key = `tolower(AppDisplayName)` + `tolower(UserPrincipalName)`.
- `AccessType = Authenticated` when a matching Entra sign-in exists for that app + user, otherwise `Unauthenticated`.

> **Limitation:** an app that authenticates through a **non-Entra IdP (e.g. PingID)** has **no Entra sign-in**, so it shows **Unauthenticated** even though the user really did authenticate. Bring the PingID logs in and add them as an extra authentication source to correct this.

### Adding PingID logs as an authentication source
1. **Ingest** PingID / PingOne logs into this workspace (custom-log / AMA connector, Logstash, or the PingOne → Sentinel connector). Assume the table is `PingID_CL` with fields for the user, the application/service, the result, and `TimeGenerated`.
2. **Normalize** them to the same key columns `AppName` (lower-cased app) and `UPN` (lower-cased email/UPN).
3. **Union** into the `Auth` set in Approach D so a PingID success also counts as `Authenticated`.

```kql
// 1) PingID authenticated usage, normalized to the SAME keys used by Approach D
let AuthPing = PingID_CL
    | where tostring(column_ifexists('result_s','')) has 'SUCCESS'
    | summarize SignIns = count()
        by AppName = tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('application_s',''))),
           UPN = tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('user_s','')));
// 2) Entra authenticated usage (same as today)
let AuthEntra = union isfuzzy=true (SigninLogs), (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs)
    | where ResultType == '0'
    | summarize SignIns = count()
        by AppName = tolower(AppDisplayName), UPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
// 3) Combine BOTH identity providers into one authenticated set
let Auth = union isfuzzy=true (AuthEntra), (AuthPing)
    | summarize SignIns = sum(SignIns) by AppName, UPN;
// ...then join MdaUsage to Auth exactly as Approach D already does.
```

Replace `result_s`, `application_s`, `user_s` with the real PingID column names once the table exists. The **same pattern works for any additional IdP** (Okta, ADFS, etc.): normalize each source to `AppName` + `UPN`, then `union` it into `Auth`. To also show *which* IdP authenticated the user, add `| extend IdP = 'PingID'` (and `'Entra'` on the other branch) before the union and carry it through the join.
